basis:
Independent arithmetic: segment A horizontal distance 111.19 m, segment B 111.19 m; total 222.38 m, rounded to 222 m. Elevation A: 0→50 is +50 m; B: 50→0 is −50 m. Minimum 0 m, maximum 50 m. Grade on each pair: 50 / 111.19 × 100 = 44.97%, rounded to 45.0%. Profile keeps all 4 points, below the 160-point cap.

Steps: ["Each segment is measured independently; the gap between the last point of segment A and the first point of segment B is not joined.", "At the equator, 0.001 degree of latitude is about 111.19 metres, so each of the two segments contributes one horizontal distance.", "Ascent sums only positive elevation differences; descent sums the absolute value of negative differences.", "Grade is computed for point pairs at least 5 metres apart: 50 ÷ 111.19 × 100% ≈ 45.0% on each pair."]
Notes: Common mistake: joining the two endpoints across the 0.002-degree gap, which would add an extra horizontal distance and a flat 50-metre connector. The tool does not connect separate segments.
